document.abstract: In storage-type television film pickup systems, usual either the light source is pulsed or else a mechanical shutter is used on the projector. This paper describes a third method, wherein the film is projected continuously, even during pulldown, on the photocathode of an image-orthicon tube. The image section of the tube, however, is keyed electronically so that it operates only during vertical blanking. Simple apparatus for the use with studio cameras is described.
